name: Verdurous-Counterscarp
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by towering mountain ranges. Farther poleward, past a nearby asteroid belt, the silence feels older than the soil.

The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in iron here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
